scripts.build: npm run build:fonts && npm run build:icons
scripts.lint: echo 'No JavaScript to lint - nldesign is CSS/PHP only'

scripts.phpmd: phpmd lib text phpmd.xml || echo 'PHPMD not installed, skipping...'
scripts.check: E=0; for CMD in lint phpcs psalm test:unit; do echo; echo "=== $CMD ==="; composer $CMD || E=1; done; echo; if [ $E -eq 0 ]; then echo "ALL CHECKS PASSED"; else echo "SOME CHECKS FAILED (see above)"; fi; exit $E
scripts.check:full: E=0; for CMD in lint phpcs psalm phpstan test:all; do echo; echo "=== $CMD ==="; composer $CMD || E=1; done; echo; if [ $E -eq 0 ]; then echo "ALL CHECKS PASSED"; else echo "SOME CHECKS FAILED (see above)"; fi; exit $E
scripts.check:strict: E=0; for CMD in lint phpcs phpmd psalm phpstan test:all; do echo; echo "=== $CMD ==="; composer $CMD || E=1; done; echo; if [ $E -eq 0 ]; then echo "ALL CHECKS PASSED"; else echo "SOME CHECKS FAILED (see above)"; fi; exit $E
scripts.quality:phpcs-score: ./vendor/bin/phpcs --standard=phpcs.xml --report=json lib/ | php -r "\$json = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://stdin'), true); \$errors = \$json['totals']['errors'] ?? 0; \$warnings = \$json['totals']['warnings'] ?? 0; \$score = 1000 - \$errors - (\$warnings / 2); echo 'PHPCS Score: ' . \$score . ' (Errors: ' . \$errors . ', Warnings: ' . \$warnings . ')' . PHP_EOL;"
scripts.quality:phpmd-score: phpmd lib/ json phpmd.xml | php -r "\$input = file_get_contents('php://stdin'); \$json = json_decode(\$input, true); \$violations = count(\$json['files'] ?? []); \$score = 1000 - (\$violations * 10); echo 'PHPMD Score: ' . \$score . ' (Violations: ' . \$violations . ')' . PHP_EOL;" || echo 'PHPMD not available'
scripts.quality:psalm-score: ./vendor/bin/psalm --output-format=json --no-cache | php -r "\$input = file_get_contents('php://stdin'); \$json = json_decode(\$input, true); \$errors = count(\$json ?? []); \$score = 1000 - (\$errors * 5); echo 'Psalm Score: ' . \$score . ' (Errors: ' . \$errors . ')' . PHP_EOL;" || echo 'Psalm not available'
scripts.quality:phpstan-score: ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G --error-format=json --no-progress | php -r "\$input = file_get_contents('php://stdin'); \$json = json_decode(\$input, true); \$errors = \$json['totals']['file_errors'] ?? 0; \$score = 1000 - (\$errors * 5); echo 'PHPStan Score: ' . \$score . ' (Errors: ' . \$errors . ')' . PHP_EOL;" || echo 'PHPStan not available'

lines: Version drift: appinfo/info.xml says 0.1.2, package.json says 0.1.0.
The App Store and the server read info.xml; everything on the node side reads package.json. Whichever is behind, a release ends up carrying two version numbers, and only one of them reaches the user.
Node versions disagree: 18 (documentation.yml), 20 (sync-tokens.yml).
The release is built on one of them and a contributor may build on another; a different major gets a different lockfile and, with a native dependency, a different build.
composer.json scripts test:unit, test:all, test:coverage call phpunit, and no PHPUnit configuration is in the checkout.
./vendor/bin/phpunit --colors=always || echo 'Tests require Nextcloud environment, skipping...'
The command is there to be run, so whoever runs it gets a tool that has nothing to go by - and CI, if it runs the script, reports the failure as the change under test.
The licence is stated differently: agpl (appinfo/info.xml), AGPL-3.0-or-later (package.json), EUPL-1.2 (composer.json).
Whoever redistributes the app has to pick one of them, and the App Store shows the one from info.xml.
agpl in appinfo/info.xml is a deprecated App Store value, shown there as AGPLv3+, which is AGPL-3.0-or-later. An SPDX id there needs a <nextcloud> min-version of 31 or higher.
No LICENSES/ directory, so the licence text itself is not in the checkout, which is what REUSE and the distributions check for.
Declares Nextcloud 28 to 33; the oldest maintained major is 32 (as of 2026-09), the newest released 35 (the release tags of nextcloud/server).
min-version 28 reaches below the oldest maintained major (32), which means the code has to keep working with APIs that are no longer tested upstream.
Tooling in the checkout: Stylelint (stylelint.config.js), Psalm (psalm.xml).
No ESLint configuration: nothing checks the frontend sources, so a wrong import is found by the build or not at all.
No PHPUnit configuration: there is no test harness in the checkout, so nothing can be run against a change.
No PHP-CS-Fixer configuration: no coding standard is applied to the PHP sources, so formatting is settled in review instead of by a command.
No REUSE configuration: licensing is not machine-checkable, which the App Store and every distribution ask for.
No EditorConfig configuration: indentation is whatever each contributor's editor does.
1 declared package is named nowhere in the checkout: @amsterdam/design-system-react-icons.

Searched as literal names over 159 files, package.json excluded apart from its non-dependency fields, lockfiles excluded; then as an ESLint shorthand, as what TypeScript takes from a tsconfig, and as a peer of an installed package in package-lock.json. A package loaded some other way is not named anywhere either, so this is a list to check, not a list to remove.
appinfo/info.xml links its repository and its bug tracker.
PHP 8.1 is the floor in appinfo/info.xml and in composer.json, platform 8.1.
package-lock.json (lockfileVersion 2) and composer.lock in the checkout.
The ncmake bootstrap stub is in place (21 lines).
Every directory the shipped PHP reaches through __DIR__ and the frontend through linkTo is in the shipped file set (the ncmake core and ncmake.mk).
